ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Welfare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of welfare fraud in Minnesota and identify potential perpetrators.
questions: What is the extent of welfare fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant fraud and abuse in the welfare system. By following the money and tracking the flow of funds, we may be able to identify potential perpetrators and bring them to justice.
